access: Hugging Face weights Soul-AILab/SoulX-Podcast-1.7B-dialect (about 2.06B parameters in the file listing)
Soul-AILab/SoulX-Podcast repository with a command-line script, a web UI and a Docker image with vLLM support

voice.input_audio: A JSON script of speaker turns with a reference clip and its transcript for each speaker; tags inside the turn text [gh-soulx]
voice.output_audio: A wav file written by the command-line script; the pages read state no sample rate [gh-soulx]
voice.voices: custom cloning from a reference clip for each speaker; cross-dialect cloning [hf-soulx]
languages: Mandarin and English; the dialect checkpoint adds Chinese dialects, named as Sichuanese, Henanese and Cantonese [hf-soulx-d]
voice.turn_detection: none: a synthesis model; speaker turns are marked in the script [gh-soulx]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model; streaming inference was not yet supported [hf-soulx]
voice.session_limit: The paper reports continuous conversation of more than 90 minutes with stable timbre [arxiv-soulx]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights, free under Apache-2.0. No GPU memory figure is stated on the pages read

unknown: generation: the maker numbers no generation
released: the Hugging Face repositories were created 2025-10-27 and the paper was submitted the same day [hf-soulx-d-api] [arxiv-soulx]
